questions.stem: What is one disadvantage of dialysis as a treatment for kidney failure?

options.text: It permanently damages the remaining kidney tissue
It must be carried out regularly, which restricts the patient's lifestyle
It cannot remove urea from the blood
It requires the patient to take immunosuppressant drugs

questions.explanation: Dialysis must be carried out regularly, typically three times a week for several hours each session. This significantly restricts the patient's daily activities and quality of life compared to a successful transplant.
